import java.util.Map;
import java.util.Scanner;
import java.util.TreeMap;

public class Cutting {
    public static void main(String[] args) {
        Scanner scanner = new Scanner(System.in);
        int n = scanner.nextInt();
        int b = scanner.nextInt();
        int[] a = new int[n];
        for (int i = 0; i < n; i++) {
            a[i] = scanner.nextInt();
        }

        TreeMap<Integer, Integer> costs = new TreeMap<Integer, Integer>();
        int odd = 0;
        int even = 0;
        for (int i = 0; i < n - 1; i++) {
            if ((a[i] & 1) == 0) {
                even++;
            } else {
                odd++;
            }
            if (odd == even) {
                int cost = Math.abs(a[i] - a[i + 1]);
                Integer current = costs.get(cost);
                costs.put(cost, current == null ? 1 : current + 1);
            }
        }

        int spent = 0;
        int cuts = 0;
        for (Map.Entry<Integer, Integer> entry : costs.entrySet()) {
            int cost = entry.getKey();
            int count = entry.getValue();
            if (spent > b) {
                break;
            }
            if (cost == 0) {
                cuts += count;
                continue;
            }
            int canTake = (b - spent) / cost;
            int take = Math.min(count, canTake);
            cuts += take;
            spent += take * cost;
            if (take < count) {
                break;
            }
        }
        System.out.println(cuts);
    }
}
